svg.text: Business Licensing & Renewal Portal — Application Component Architecture
C4 Application Component Topology: Presentation Workspaces → API & Zero-Leak BFF Pipeline → Domain Microservices & Agentic AI → Repositories & Outbox
1. Presentation & Omnichannel Experience Modules (Role-Separated Views & AI Assistant Drawer)
HTTPS / JSON REST · Role-Scoped UI Actions
2. API Contract Mediation, RBAC/State Guard & Zero-Leak ViewModel/DTO Pipeline (Sequential Request Filter)
3A. Core Domain & Workflow Services (Deterministic State Machine, Business Rules & Escalation)
✓ Enforces Lifecycle State Table · ✓ Deterministic Calculations · ✓ Separation-of-Duties Guards
ACID SQL Unit-of-Work · Transactional Event Outbox · Append-Only Audit
4. Data Access Repositories, Cryptographic Adapters & Outbound Integration Ports
